annotations.why: The Lycaonians called Barnabas Jupiter and Paul Mercurius, 'because he was the chief speaker': the name is the god's, said of Paul, and not the Hermes whom Paul salutes at Rome (ROM 16:14).
'Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts': the god of Babylon, not the forefather of the children of Nebo who returned (Ezra 2:29).
